subject: Microsegmentation & VPC expansion at renewal — implementation and T&C alignment
messages:
From: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@medivance.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: John Patel <john.patel@medivance.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Microseg & VPC expansion at renewal - initial ask

Hi Aditya,

As we get closer to our Oct 1 renewal, we wanted to surface a change in scope and make sure we have alignment on timeline and commercial terms. In short, Medivance wants to:  

- Expand our Private VPC footprint to include a dedicated EU environment (West-EU) for PHI processing.
- Add two additional on-prem cluster replicas for islanded analytics (on-prem appliance model).
- Apply microsegmentation/isolation so that analytics workloads are separated from our prod inference environment (strict tenancy).

High level asks from your side:  
- Rough pricing delta and term options if we convert to a 36-month committed term with an upfront credit.
- A draft SOW for the on-prem configuration (network pre-reqs, install window, responsibilities).
- Confirmation we can stage a canary cutover in West-EU for 30 days before a full roll.

I'm attaching our current topology snapshot and a SOC2 excerpt for reference. Can we get a quick sync this week? Prefer mornings (CEST) on Wed/Thu.

Thanks,
Anna Ruiz
Head of Cloud Operations
Medivance Health
Attachments: medivance-current-topo.pdf (pdf), soc2-excerpt.pdf (pdf)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
To: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@medivance.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, monica_patel@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Microseg & VPC expansion at renewal - initial ask

Anna — thanks for the clear summary. We can definitely support the EU Private environment plus two on-prem replicas and a staged canary approach.

Quick responses:  
- We'll produce a draft SOW and a pricing delta deck by EOD Fri.
- High-level commercial options: month-to-month uplift, 12/24/36-month commit tiers (36 gives material unit discounts).
- Technical: microsegmentation will require network ACLs + optional customer-managed KMS for the PHI cluster. I'll bring in Kimberly (Pricing) and Monica (Deploy) into the thread.

Proposed next steps:  
1) 30-min technical + procurement sync this Thu 08:00-08:30 CEST (I can host).
2) We circulate a draft SOW + pricing; you review and mark redlines.
3) Legal/Proc runs a quick review, then DocuSign for signatures.

If that works, I'll schedule the call.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, monica_patel@redwood.example.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Microseg & VPC expansion at renewal - pricing + SOW ask

Team — forwarding Medivance ask (see Anna below). They want a 36-month commit option with upfront credit and two on-prem replicas + EU private environment isolated for PHI. Action items:  

- Kimberly: please produce a pricing delta table for 12/24/36 months, including one-time on-prem install (labour + appliance shipping) and estimated per-token unit for dedicated EU env. Include a separate line for canary (30-day discounted trial). Target: initial draft by Fri EOD.
- Monica: draft a high-level SOW (deploy phases, required customer network pre-reqs, expected outage windows, runbook owner). Attach as Word doc.
- Lauren: can you flag any legal/contract constraints around expanded data residency + 36-month prepay? Also confirm if we need any SLAs adjusted for on-prem pieces.

Background: Medivance is a strategic mid-market healthcare customer; retention is high but this expansion includes PHI segmentation so security needs to be explicit.

I'll join pricing call on Thu. Thanks — please copy me on all drafts.

—Aditya

From: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com, monica_patel@redwood.example.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Microseg & VPC expansion at renewal - pricing + SOW ask

Aditya / Monica — draft numbers below (high level):  

Pricing (dedicated Private EU env + 2 on-prem replicas) — monthly run-rate estimates (USD):  
- Month-to-month uplift: +$22,000/mo (no commit).
- 12-month commit: +$18,500/mo (5% discount applied).
- 24-month commit: +$15,800/mo (15% discount applied).
- 36-month commit: +$12,900/mo (30% discount applied) + one-time setup credit rebate if paid upfront (TBD by finance).

On-prem install (one-time): $45,000 (includes shipping and 2 FTE-days onsite for install).
Canary (30-day trial): we can offer a prorated credit equal to 50% of a single month of the agreed blank rate.

Open technical clarifications needed from Medivance:  
- Sustained QPS and p99 latency targets for the analytics cluster.
- Expected token volume / embeddings storage growth (for shard sizing).
- Whether they will manage the HSM/KMS or we do RMK integration.

I've attached a first-pass draft SOW (draft-sow-microseg-v1.docx). Monica — please review the deployment schedule section and add acceptance criteria.

—Kimberly
Director, Pricing & GTM Finance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft-sow-microseg-v1.docx (docx)

From: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@medivance.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: John Patel <john.patel@medivance.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Microseg & VPC expansion at renewal - initial ask

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:  

- QPS: avg 220 QPS, peak 1.2k QPS; p99 latency target 120ms.
- Token volumes: we estimate 7B input tokens/month (analytics traffic mostly embeddings indexing).
- We will manage our own HSM/KMS and can provide key material via your KMS-onboarding API.

We reviewed the pricing and are inclined toward the 36-month prepay if finance can confirm the upfront rebate. Can you include a network diagram? Attaching our internal network topology and a detailed network diagram (medivance-network-diagram.vsdx).

Also request: can we include a clause for a 60-day rollback window post-cutover (for safety), and a defined proof-of-concept runbook for the West-EU canary? Legal will need that spelled out.

We'd like the DocuSign flow to include distinct signature order: PE/OPS -> Legal -> CFO.

Best,
Anna
Attachments: medivance-network-diagram.vsdx (vsdx)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
To: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@medivance.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, monica_patel@redwood.example.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Microseg & VPC expansion at renewal - implementation and T&C alignment

Anna — great, thanks for the details and the network diagram. Quick summary and proposed timeline:  

Summary:  
- Scope: West-EU Private environment + 2 on-prem replicas, microsegmentation with customer-managed KMS, 36-month prepay option with upfront rebate (final rebate pending finance).
- Pricing: preliminary 36-month run-rate estimate $12,900/mo (see Kim's note). One-time on-prem install $45k.
- Compliance: we will add a 60-day rollback clause and a canary POC runbook to the SOW.

Next steps (owner / ETA):  
1) Monica: finalize SOW with runbook + acceptance criteria — Wed 23 Sep EOD.
2) Kimberly: confirm finance rebate number and produce final pricing table — Thu 24 Sep EOD.
3) Lauren: draft a contract amendment with rollback clause and signature order for DocuSign — Thu 24 Sep EOD.
4) Aditya: schedule kickoff + canary cutover window (we propose Oct 12–14 for West-EU) and prepare DocuSign envelope link.

Links & attachments: SOW draft (drive link above), DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?token=eyJhbGci...MEDV2026

If there are no material objections, I'll proceed to get Monica and Kimberly's drafts into the shared drive and send the DocuSign starter envelope by Thu.

Thanks all — looking forward to moving this across the line.

—Aditya
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: draft-sow-microseg-v1.docx, medivance-current-topo.pdf, medivance-network-diagram.vsdx
